comments.body: Took into investigation.

I have investigated the issue. The root cause of the issue is that the system cannot create portchannel due to value range restriction of `min_ports` parameter(`min-links` in terminology of sonic-utilities) inside `teamd` daemon of `libteam` library. `min_ports` parameter has allowable range 1...255. To fix the issue is just need to set range of allowable value of the parameter.
But, this is my concern. I have an information that 802.3ad standard, in which the Link Aggregation feature is described, allows only 8 active ports per LAG. If it so, it could be transformed to the top limit of the `min-links` parameter. Unfortunately, I have not copy of the standard and I cannot confirm the limitation. I found no related restrictions in SONiC design documents and source code, except the range above in `libteam`. In addition, I found yang model, in which the range of min-links is 1...128: https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/blob/ab0ee0bfae5354adbf36f6fac0144883a5222037/src/sonic-yang-models/yang-models/sonic-portchannel.yang.
Due to that, the allowable range of min-links is unclear for me..
@lguohan, I am not sure that you could help me, but could I ask you to clarify is there any restrictions of value of min-links in SONiC? Or, maybe, you could forward me to a person, who could help me in this question?

Next steps:

Also, to be discussed in YANG model subgroup for CLI check

@liat-grozovik, here is the place in libteam, where the range of min_ports is being checked: https://github.com/jpirko/libteam/blob/267f24839536234ca621d4fd0466d3b57cb6dccd/teamd/teamd_runner_lacp.c#L286
Could you ask guys from libteam to clarify from where they got the top limit value of min_ports? Maybe, there was some reason to limit it on value of UCHAR_MAX? IMO, the value is too high.

linkedPullRequests.title: Increase min-links limit for portchannel from 128 to 1024.
linkedPullRequests.author: raphaelt-nvidia
linkedPullRequests.body:
Signed-off-by: Raphael Tryster <raphaelt@nvidia.com>


#### Why I did it

Restrict the min-links parameter in "config portchannel" to the range 1-1024.
Fixes Azure/sonic-buildimage#6781 in conjunction with https://github.com/Azure/sonic-utilities/pull/1630.
Align YANG model with limits in libteam and sonic-utilties.

#### How I did it

PR 1630 in sonic-utilities prevents CLI user from entering a value outside the allowed range.  This PR does the following:

- Increases the maximum value of min-links from 128 to 1024.
- Provides validation in libteam, incorporating as a patch the code in https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/jpirko/libteam.git/commit/?id=69a7494bb77dc10bb27076add07b380dbd778592.
- Updates the Yang model upper limit from 128 to 1024 (was inconsistent with libteam value).
- Updates the Yang model lower limit from 1 to 0, since 0 is set as default in sonic-utilities which would fail its new range check otherwise.
- Added Yang tests for valid and invalid value.

#### How to verify it

config portchannel add PortChannel0004 --min-links 1024

Command should be accepted.

show interfaces portchannel

Output should show PortChannel0004, no errors on CLI.

config portchannel add PortChannel0005 --min-links 1025

Command should be rejected

show interfaces portchannel

Output should not show PortChannel0005 , no errors on CLI.

#### Which release branch to backport (provide reason below if selected)


#### Description for the changelog

Updates YANG model to allow up to 1024 min_links for portchannel.  Fixes Azure/sonic-buildimage#6781 in conjunction with https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/1630.

linkedPullRequests.title: Add range check on portchannel min-links
linkedPullRequests.author: raphaelt-nvidia
linkedPullRequests.body:
Signed-off-by: Raphael Tryster <raphaelt@nvidia.com>



#### What I did

Restrict the min-links parameter in "config portchannel" to the range 0-1024.
Fixes Azure/sonic-buildimage#6781 in conjunction with https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/7265/files.


#### How I did it

Changed
@click.option('--min-links', default=0, type=int)
to
@click.option('--min-links', default=0, type=click.IntRange(0,1024))

Note that all these need to be aligned:

the default value
the range enforced here
the limits in libteam
the limits in the yang model

The first two of these are in this PR; the last two are in the other one referred to above. The alignment was performed as follows:

the default value - remained 0
the range enforced here - previously absent, now 0-1024
the limits in libteam - maximum was 255, now 1024
the limits in the yang model - was 1-128, now 0-1024

config portchannel add PortChannel0004 --min-links 1024

show interfaces portchannel

Output should show PortChannel0004, no errors on CLI.

config portchannel add PortChannel0005 --min-links 1025
